name: Apple Calendar
_comment: No sign-in: Calendar.app on this Mac already holds every account it syncs (iCloud, Google, Exchange...). Connect runs one read against Calendar, which makes macOS ask once whether Fused may control it (Automation consent); the record stores the kind and the calendar names, never a credential. Off a Mac the card says so and offers nothing.
privacy: Fused talks to the Calendar app on this Mac, the way Shortcuts does: no sign-in, no token, and Fused sends nothing anywhere. An event in a synced calendar (iCloud, Google, Exchange) syncs through Calendar to that account as usual. macOS asks once whether to allow it (System Settings > Privacy & Security > Automation).
